about: Fixed lines the live engine must reproduce. Each total was derived from HTSUS 2026 Rev. 21/22 chapter 99 (U.S. notes 16, 20/31, 50, 52; subchapter III note 41) and the MFN column; derivation in `why`. Built 2026-10-26 from the scout benchmark of that day. Update a line only with a primary-source reason in `why`.

lines.why: MFN 2% + 232 derivative steel 25% (note 16(c)(vii) lists 7323.93.00, heading 9903.82.09); forced-labor exempt (52(f)(1)); not on a China 301 list. Benchmark case (old code: 14.5).

MFN 1.4% + China 301 25%; 7202 is on no note 16 list; forced-labor exempt because note 52(b) (heading 9903.05.86) lists 7202.11.10. The scout's 38.9% added forced-labor 12.5%, which the note excludes. Benchmark case (old code: 26.4 by luck, 232 not listed).
MFN 3.1% + 232 derivative aluminum 25% (note 16(c)(vi) lists 7615.10.2015); forced-labor exempt. Benchmark case (old code: 53.1, chapter rule 50%).
MFN free + China 301 25% + 232 derivative 25% (8418.10.00 in note 16(c)(vi) and (vii), heading 9903.82.09). Benchmark case (old code: no 232).
232 derivative 25%; forced-labor exempt (52(f)(1)).

Quartz slab: MFN free + China 301 List 3 25% + forced-labor 12.5% + Section 201 quartz safeguard 25% within quota (9903.45.30; 50% over quota under 9903.45.31, year 15 Aug 2026-14 Aug 2027, note 41(e)). China is not exempt under note 41(c). HTSUS 2026 Rev. 22 ch. 99 subchapter III U.S. note 41 + headings 9903.45.30/.31 (Proclamation 11051, FR Doc. 2026-15975, 91 FR 50645; read 31 Oct 2026). Old engine: 37.5 (no safeguard).

Quartz slab from India: MFN free + forced-labor 10% + Section 201 25% within quota. India is NOT on the note 41(c)(iii) developing-country list, so the safeguard applies. HTSUS 2026 Rev. 22 ch. 99 subchapter III U.S. note 41 + headings 9903.45.30/.31 (Proclamation 11051, FR Doc. 2026-15975, 91 FR 50645; read 31 Oct 2026). Old engine: 10.

Quartz slab from Brazil: Brazil is on the note 41(c)(iii) developing-country list, so no safeguard; MFN free + Brazil 301 25% + forced-labor 12.5% unchanged. HTSUS 2026 Rev. 22 ch. 99 subchapter III U.S. note 41 + headings 9903.45.30/.31 (Proclamation 11051, FR Doc. 2026-15975, 91 FR 50645; read 31 Oct 2026).

Quartz slab from Canada: exempt under note 41(c)(i). The Canada section 338 note must cite Proclamation 11076 (FR Doc. 2026-22292, 91 FR 68861, scope change from 12:01 a.m. ET 30 Oct 2026; annex image-only, so may apply, verify). HTSUS 2026 Rev. 22 ch. 99 subchapter III U.S. note 41 + headings 9903.45.30/.31 (Proclamation 11051, FR Doc. 2026-15975, 91 FR 50645; read 31 Oct 2026).
